title: How it travels
sub: Data architecture, a series on what DAMA calls data architecture, between the business and the systems: how a fact travels between domains, what crosses each edge, in which shape, under which contract, and every flow drawn on the map with an owner at each end.
howto: Glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model: gold is the business layer, peach the information layer, where data architecture works. Each system is a glass card; the wall between the network and retail is a frosted band, and a path across it is a line: solid and drawn on the map, or dashed and grey when nobody drew it. A message is a small card that travels along a line. Chile in 1972 is drawn in lamp-light: the long country, its telex lines, and the strips that crossed them.
